title: PP Learning Loop — RL Formatting, Self-Calibrating Constants, Coupled Thermal-Wear, LCA
description: Wire the compound moat engines: RLPostProcessorEngine learns optimal G-code formatting per controller from shop floor feedback. PredictionCalibrationEngine auto-calibrates Kienzle kc1.1 and Taylor C/n from measured results. ThermalWearCouplingEngine replaces simplified inline thermal with coupled RK4 ODE. SustainabilityLCAEngine adds ISO 14040 CO2/energy per program.

engines: RLPostProcessorEngine (243 lines) — Q-learning G-code format optimizer
PredictionCalibrationEngine — auto-calibrate Kienzle/Taylor from real data
ThermalWearCouplingEngine — coupled RK4 ODE (Usui wear + thermal)
BayesianOptimizationEngine — GP surrogate for S/F optimization
formulas: Usui diffusion wear (C1, C2 constants per material pair)
RK4 integration for coupled thermal-wear ODE system
ISO 14040/14044 LCA (GWP, AP, EP, ODP, POCP, ADP)
Gutowski power decomposition (fixed + variable spindle power)
Bayesian posterior update for kc1.1 and Taylor C/n

forge_triple.protective_hook: pp-learning-loop-check — blocks PP edits that hardcode values that should come from calibrated constants
forge_triple.mcp_action: prism_cam post_process_learn — post-process with learning feedback endpoint
forge_triple.skill: /pp-calibrate — show calibrated vs canonical constants for a machine+material pair

units.title: Wire PredictionCalibrationEngine as Stage 0.8 — load calibrated Kienzle/Taylor constants
steps: Add PredictionCalibrationEngine to _getEngine()
Add Stage 0.7 (after smart defaults, before physics): load calibrated constants for this machine+material pair
Create persistent store schema: { machine_id, material_id, calibrated_kc1_1, calibrated_mc, calibrated_taylor_C, calibrated_taylor_n, confidence, sample_count, last_updated }
In Stage 0.7: query store → if calibration confidence > 0.6, override CANONICAL values in MaterialContext
Keep CANONICAL as fallback when no calibration exists
Add calibration_source field to analytics: 'canonical' | 'calibrated (N=47 samples)'
exit_conditions: New test: calibrated constants override canonical when confidence > 0.6
New test: no calibration data → graceful fallback to canonical
units.description: Wire PredictionCalibrationEngine as Stage 0.8 — load calibrated Kienzle/Taylor constants — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Wire ThermalWearCouplingEngine — coupled RK4 ODE as Stage 2.7b
steps: Add ThermalWearCouplingEngine to _getEngine()
In Phase 2 thermal tracking (Stage 2.7), replace simplified linear model with ThermalWearCouplingEngine.solve()
Input: initial VB=0, T_room, Vc, fz, ap, ae, material Usui constants
Output: per-block VB(t), T_tool(t), dimensional_error(t)
Feed coupled state into wear progression (Stage 2.6) and deflection (Stage 1.5)
Track cumulative state across tool sections (state persists across tool changes via reset)
exit_conditions: New test: coupled ODE produces monotonically increasing VB over cutting time
New test: thermal rise accelerates wear rate (coupling verified)
New test: dimensional error accumulation tracked in analytics
units.description: Wire ThermalWearCouplingEngine — coupled RK4 ODE as Stage 2.7b — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Wire RLPostProcessorEngine as Stage 6.1c — RL-learned G-code formatting per controller
steps: Add RLPostProcessorEngine to _getEngine()
Add Stage 6.1b (between G-code generation 6.1 and controller params 6.4)
Load Q-table for this controller family from persistent store
Pass generated G-code through rlPostProcessorEngine.generateCode() with per-move type formatting decisions
Save updated Q-table after generation (learning happens on feedback, not generation)
Create feedback API endpoint: POST /api/v1/ppg/feedback — accepts { program_id, cycle_time_actual, errors, surface_quality }
On feedback: call rlPostProcessorEngine.learn() to update Q-table rewards
exit_conditions: New test: RL engine produces valid G-code (syntax check passes)
New test: Q-table persists across pipeline runs
Feedback endpoint accepts and processes learning data
units.description: Wire RLPostProcessorEngine as Stage 6.1c — RL-learned G-code formatting per controller — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Wire SustainabilityLCAEngine into Stage 5.5b + Analytics — ISO 14040 CO2/energy per program
steps: Add SustainabilityLCAEngine and SustainabilityEngine to _getEngine()
Replace Stage 5.5 inline energy heuristic with SustainabilityEngine.compute()
In Stage 6.5 (analytics report), add LCA section from SustainabilityLCAEngine:
co2_kg_per_part, energy_kWh_per_part, coolant_cost_per_part, sustainability_score (0-100)
LCA categories: GWP, AP, EP per ISO 14040
Add sustainability fields to PipelineResult type
exit_conditions: New test: analytics report includes co2_kg_per_part field
New test: different materials/coolants produce different LCA scores

exit_gate: Learning loop wired: calibrated constants (Stage 0.7), coupled thermal-wear (Stage 2), RL formatting (Stage 6.1b), sustainability LCA (Stage 5.5/6.5). Feedback API endpoint active. /prism-review passed.
